<section class="atlas-workspace" aria-label="Interactive MDS explorer">

</section>

<section class="atlas-reading">
  <div class="atlas-section-heading">
    <span class="atlas-kicker">Interpretation</span>
    <h2>How to read this space</h2>
  </div>
  <div class="atlas-reading-grid">
    <article>
      <span>01</span>
      <h3>Modality</h3>
      <p>The first dimension tests whether gustatory and auditory stimuli separate by sensory modality.</p>
    </article>
    <article>
      <span>02</span>
      <h3>Valence</h3>
      <p>The second dimension captures the strong separation of sweet stimuli from the other taste categories.</p>
    </article>
    <article>
      <span>03</span>
      <h3>Arousal</h3>
      <p>The third dimension distinguishes the higher-arousal sour pattern from the lower-arousal bitter pattern.</p>
    </article>
  </div>
</section>

<section class="atlas-method-strip" aria-label="Study summary">
  <span><strong>16</strong> stimuli</span>
  <span><strong>2</strong> modalities</span>
  <span><strong>18</strong> rating scales</span>
  <span><strong>3D</strong> MDS</span>
  <span><strong>Vector</strong> fitting</span>
</section>

</div>
